cards.text: Genesis 5 is a family album from Adam, the first man, down to Noah, and one after another, each man lives hundreds of years and then dies. But not Enoch: "Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away." Methuselah lives the longest of them all, 969 years. The line comes down to Noah, who has three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
Then men begin to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters are born to them. That family album is gonna need a SECOND album.

cards.question: The sons of God see that the daughters of men are beautiful. What do the sons of God do?

answers.text: Take as wives whomever they choose
Wait for the LORD to choose for them
Ask the fathers for their permission

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks: "My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years."
The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and afterward as well, when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men. Their children became "the mighty men of old, men of renown."
And here, friend, the story turns. The LORD looks at man on the earth.

cards.question: The LORD sees that the ___ of man is great upon the earth.
The LORD looks at the thoughts of man's heart. True or false: those thoughts are evil only some of the time.

cards.text: The LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth. This part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: The LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth. True or false: He was also grieved in His heart.
The LORD is grieved that He made man. What does the LORD say He will do?

answers.text: Blot out man from the earth

cards.question: The LORD says He will blot out man from the face of the earth. True or false: He names the beasts and the birds of the air too.
The LORD says He will blot out man from the face of the earth. But one man stands apart. Who finds favor in the eyes of the LORD?

cards.text: Keep your eye on Noah, friend. The oven timer on this story hasn't even dinged yet.
